next.reason: 1985: "The evaluation of length must result in a positive nonzero integer."; 2023: "shall result in a positive nonzero integer, unless the REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH directive is set to ON, when the result may also be zero.". Same definition of the unique data item, but 2023 adds a case: with the REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH directive on, a zero length is allowed. It also adds bit positions and EC-BOUND-REF-MOD.
